info.title: Fax for Agents API
info.description: A fax API built for AI agents. Keys: Authorization: Bearer ffa_live_... or X-API-Key. Each operation lists the credentials it takes under security and the scope it asks for in x-required-scope. An operation with an empty security list takes no credential. Every error is one envelope: error.code, error.message, error.retryable, error.correlation_id. OAuth access tokens of the hosted MCP server are not accepted here.

put.summary: Let connected apps send without asking, inside two limits (owner)
put.description: The environment comes from X-FFA-Environment. When enabled, every connected app of the organization (OAuth connections such as ChatGPT or Claude, and API keys flagged connected_app) sends in that environment with no approval per fax, inside the amount per fax and the faxes per day. A hosted integration the server marks requires_human_approval still needs a person. The first enable creates a managed policy; every later save is a new policy version with its audit row. A browser session needs a sign-in from the last 15 minutes.

post.summary: Create a one-time order from a live quote the wallet does not cover
post.description: The quote supplies the document, the destination and the cover; the price is the card's one-time price, not the quote's. The quote then belongs to the order. Needs a live key with fax:send. A key needs what a wallet send of the quote needs: approval_id, or a delegated policy that allows the send. Paying by card replaces neither; without one the answer is 403 approval_required.

post.description: Answers the hosted payment page of the order. The card is authorized there, not charged: it is charged when the carrier confirms delivery. scopes.title: Scopes
scopes.description: Omit for the default agent set. Never approval:decide, key:admin, policy:admin, agent:admin.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: false revokes every key of the agent.

connected_app.title: Connected App
connected_app.description: The key belongs to a connected app used over stdio, such as the Gemini CLI extension. The organization's auto-send setting (Settings, Connected apps) binds it like an OAuth connection.

scopes.title: Scopes
scopes.description: Omit for the default agent set; '*' for all.

connected_app.title: Connected App
connected_app.description: This key is for a connected app such as the Gemini CLI extension: the auto-send setting binds it. Not available on an agent's key.

connected_app.title: Connected App
connected_app.description: The key belongs to a connected app used over stdio, such as the Gemini CLI extension. The organization's auto-send setting (Settings, Connected apps) binds it like an OAuth connection.

secret.title: Secret
secret.description: Shown once. Store it now; it cannot be read back.

notified.title: Notified
notified.description: On creation: whether the organization was mailed. false when the request repeats a pending one or the organization's daily cap of request mails is reached; the request is still shown in the dashboard.

message.title: Message
message.description: What the person should know (kind help). Shown as data.

max_amount_micro.title: Max Amount Micro
max_amount_micro.description: Amount per fax, at most, in micro-units of USD.

daily_max_jobs.title: Daily Max Jobs
daily_max_jobs.description: Faxes per UTC day, at most, across every connected app.

policy_id.title: Policy Id
policy_id.description: The managed policy; null before the first enable.

AutoSendSetting.title: AutoSendSetting
AutoSendSetting.description:
The organization's auto-send setting for one environment: Settings, Connected apps, "Let connected
apps send without asking". Stored as the managed policy ``policy_id`` (docs/APPROVALS.md).

max_amount_micro.title: Max Amount Micro
max_amount_micro.description: Amount per fax, at most, in micro-units of USD (5000000 = $5.00).

setup_url.title: Setup Url
setup_url.description: Where to save the card while status is pending_setup.

threshold_micro.title: Threshold Micro
threshold_micro.description: Top up when the available balance drops below this.

daily_cap_micro.title: Daily Cap Micro
daily_cap_micro.description: Never more than this per UTC day.

top_up_url.title: Top Up Url
top_up_url.description: The dashboard page where a person adds funds to the wallet. A key cannot top up.

extraction_pricing.title: Extraction Pricing
extraction_pricing.description: What POST /v1/extractions charges, in micro-units. page_micro is for every page read. escalated_page_micro is added for a page the stronger model reads again. max_pages is the most pages one extraction reads. Sandbox extractions are free.

strict.title: Strict
strict.description: Refuse with page_limit_exceeded when the document has more pages than would be read, instead of reading the first ones and warning.

text.title: Text
text.description: Plain text rendered to a letter PDF.

markdown.title: Markdown
markdown.description: Markdown (headings, lists, emphasis, code) rendered to PDF.

html.title: Html
html.description: HTML rendered to PDF by a headless browser with scripts off and no network: inline CSS and data: images print, external resources are counted as blocked. US letter unless @page says otherwise. At most 2 MiB.

DocumentCreate.title: DocumentCreate
DocumentCreate.description: Send exactly one of text, markdown, html or upload_id.

requires_human_approval.title: Requires Human Approval
requires_human_approval.description: Server-set for hosted integration clients and their keys: every send needs a person's approval, whatever the policies say.

document_pages.title: Document Pages
document_pages.description: The document's page count. Above pages_processed on a completed row means the cap left pages unread; output.truncated and a warning say so.

schema.title: Schema
schema.description: A JSON Schema object of string, number, boolean or date fields with descriptions.

approval_id.title: Approval Id
approval_id.description: An approved approval request bound to this quote. Consumed by this one send.

FaxCreate.title: FaxCreate
FaxCreate.description:
M9: an approved request authorizes the send; without one a quote that needs authorization is
evaluated against the caller's delegated policies.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.description: The carrier's evidence once delivered or partial; null before.

one_time_order_id.title: One Time Order Id
one_time_order_id.description: The one-time order this fax was paid by; null for a wallet fax.

next.title: Next
next.description: An in-app path to open after sign-in.

ref.title: Ref
ref.description: A referral code from the link that brought the person, when the page has one.

role.title: Role
role.description: Required. Optional in the schema so a foreign id is a 404 first.

email_pdf.title: Email Pdf
email_pdf.description: When true, the notice mail of a fax received on this number carries the PDF as an attachment. Live numbers only. Off by default.

recurring_charge_micro.title: Recurring Charge Micro
recurring_charge_micro.description: Charged every month on the activation day.

first_month_hold_micro.title: First Month Hold Micro
first_month_hold_micro.description: Held now, captured when the number activates.

project_id.title: Project Id
project_id.description: Inbound faxes are filed under this project.

inbound_webhook_id.title: Inbound Webhook Id
inbound_webhook_id.description: The webhook that receives fax.received for this number (default: all).

email_pdf.title: Email Pdf
email_pdf.description: Attach the PDF of each received fax to the notice mail. The mail goes to the verified address of an owner of the organization and to no other address. A PDF over 15 MB is not attached. It needs the scope number:buy. An agent, an OAuth connection and a connected app are refused.

name.title: Name
name.description: The client's own name, shown as text beside the host.

host.title: Host
host.description: The host the person is sending a credential to: the trust anchor.

loopback.title: Loopback
loopback.description: The redirect goes to the person's own computer (an app they started).

first_seen.title: First Seen
first_seen.description: This client was registered during this request.

auto_send.title: Auto Send
auto_send.description: The consent screen's checkbox, owners only: false turns the organization's auto-send setting off for this environment, true turns it on with its current limits. Omitted leaves it.

scopes.title: Scopes
scopes.description: What the grant would carry for this organization and role.

auto_send.title: Auto Send
auto_send.description: The organization's auto-send setting per environment: whether connected apps send within the limits with no approval per fax (docs/APPROVALS.md, Auto-send setting).

redirect_to.title: Redirect To
redirect_to.description: Where the browser goes next: the client's registered redirect URI.

queue.description: The wait a fax ordered now would face for a carrier line. Null when one-time sends are closed here or the carrier has no line limit.

OneTimeConfig.title: OneTimeConfig
OneTimeConfig.description:
What the public send page and an agent read before an order: whether the product is open here, the
card the order will be priced from (present only while open), the document limits and the policy the
sender accepts. Prices are integer micro-USD; the dollar figure is the client's to format.

token.title: Token
token.description: The token of the link in the confirmation mail.

OneTimeConfirmSummary.title: OneTimeConfirmSummary
OneTimeConfirmSummary.description:
What the confirm page shows before the click. ``state`` is ``ok`` while the link can still be used,
else ``link_used`` or ``link_expired``. Reading it consumes nothing.

OneTimeConfirmed.title: OneTimeConfirmed
OneTimeConfirmed.description:
``signed_in`` says whether this browser now holds a session for the payer; ``me`` is then the same
object ``GET /v1/auth/me`` answers (the CSRF token included).

sender_name.title: Sender Name
sender_name.description: Printed on the cover sheet. 2 to 120 characters.

accept_aup.title: Accept Aup
accept_aup.description: A session sends true: the signed-in person accepts the acceptable use policy and the terms. A key's value is not recorded: the person who pays accepts on the order's page.

approval_id.title: Approval Id
approval_id.description: An approved, unused approval request for this quote (POST /v1/approval-requests). A key needs it unless a delegated policy allows the send. A session needs none.

delete_after_send.title: Delete After Send
delete_after_send.description: Delete the document and the transmitted copy the moment the fax ends in delivered, partial or failed. The order, the receipt and the carrier evidence stay; they hold no document content. A fax that ends unknown keeps the document until the carrier reports, or until the retention period ends. Left out, the quote's own delete_after_send applies.

refunded_micro.title: Refunded Micro
refunded_micro.description: What was refunded to the card after the charge, in micro-units.

document_pages.title: Document Pages
document_pages.description: The pages of the order's document. The cover sheet is not counted.

OneTimeJob.title: OneTimeJob
OneTimeJob.description: The order behind a fax job that a one-time send made: what was authorized, what was charged.

delete_after_send.title: Delete After Send
delete_after_send.description: The sender asked for the document and the transmitted copy to be deleted the moment the fax ends in delivered, partial or failed.

document_deleted.title: Document Deleted
document_deleted.description: True once no copy of the document is held: it was deleted after the send, by the retention period or by its owner, or the order ended before it was released and the uploaded file was removed. The order, the fax and the carrier evidence stay; they hold no document content.

document_expires_at.title: Document Expires At
document_expires_at.description: When the retention period deletes the stored document. Null before the release and once the document is deleted.

refunded_micro.title: Refunded Micro
refunded_micro.description: What was refunded to the card after the charge, in micro-units, as the ledger holds it. Zero when nothing was refunded. captured_micro stays what was charged.

resend_allowed_at.title: Resend Allowed At
resend_allowed_at.description: When the confirmation mail may be asked for again; null when it may not.

queue.description: The wait for a carrier line while the order has not ended and its fax is not on a line yet. Null for an ended order, a fax that is sending, and a test order.

aup_accepted.title: Aup Accepted
aup_accepted.description: Whether a person accepted the acceptable use policy and the terms for this order. False for an order a key created until the payer accepts on the order's page; the checkout needs it.

status_url.title: Status Url
status_url.description: The order's page for the person who pays or confirms, with a fresh status token. Present on a read by a key or session of the order's organization while the order is not done.

fax.title: Fax
fax.description: The fax job (the FaxJob shape) once the order was released; null before.

OneTimeOrder.title: OneTimeOrder
OneTimeOrder.description:
One order of the one-time send. ``next`` is what the caller does now: ``checkout`` (open the
payment), ``confirm`` (the payer clicks the link in the mail), ``wait`` (nothing to do; read again) or
``done``. Money is integer micro-USD. ``captured_micro`` is what the card was charged, written only
once the payment provider confirmed it. ``fax`` is the fax job once the order was released, with the
carrier's evidence once it has any.

delete_after_send.title: Delete After Send
delete_after_send.description: The sender asked for the document and the transmitted copy to be deleted the moment the fax ends in delivered, partial or failed.

document_deleted.title: Document Deleted
document_deleted.description: True once no copy of the document is held: it was deleted after the send, by the retention period or by its owner, or the order ended before it was released and the uploaded file was removed. The order, the fax and the carrier evidence stay; they hold no document content.

document_expires_at.title: Document Expires At
document_expires_at.description: When the retention period deletes the stored document. Null before the release and once the document is deleted.

refunded_micro.title: Refunded Micro
refunded_micro.description: What was refunded to the card after the charge, in micro-units, as the ledger holds it. Zero when nothing was refunded. captured_micro stays what was charged.

resend_allowed_at.title: Resend Allowed At
resend_allowed_at.description: When the confirmation mail may be asked for again; null when it may not.

queue.description: The wait for a carrier line while the order has not ended and its fax is not on a line yet. Null for an ended order, a fax that is sending, and a test order.

aup_accepted.title: Aup Accepted
aup_accepted.description: Whether a person accepted the acceptable use policy and the terms for this order. False for an order a key created until the payer accepts on the order's page; the checkout needs it.

fax.title: Fax
fax.description: The fax job (the FaxJob shape) once the order was released; null before.

OneTimeOrderCreated.title: OneTimeOrderCreated
OneTimeOrderCreated.description:
The create answer: the order plus the status token. The token reads this one order, opens its
checkout and asks for the confirmation mail again, with no key and no session, for seven days. Send it
as ``X-FFA-Order-Token`` (or ``?t=``). ``status_url`` is the order's page in the app with the token.

OneTimeQueue.title: OneTimeQueue
OneTimeQueue.description:
The wait for a carrier line. ``queued`` is true when a fax sent now, or this order's waiting fax,
is estimated to wait more than ten minutes for a line: the order is kept and sent in turn, never
dropped. The minutes are an estimate from the number of faxes ahead and the carrier's line count.

managed.title: Managed
managed.description: connected_apps when a Settings switch (the auto-send setting) manages this policy. Such a policy is read here and changed only through PUT /v1/organizations/current/auto-send.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.description: Why this policy exists. Shown, never evaluated.

rules.title: Rules
rules.description: See the PolicyRules schema in docs/APPROVALS.md.

from.title: From
from.description: A number you own; omit for the shared pool.

cover.title: Cover
cover.description: Cover sheet fields: to_name, from_name, subject, message. Counts as a page.

quality.title: Quality
quality.description: Fax resolution. standard is the fax standard's 204 by 98 dpi, fine (the default) 204 by 196, superfine 204 by 392. ultra asks the carrier for its darkest text processing at the same superfine resolution and takes longer to process: measured 2026-11-09, a page sent at ultra and one at superfine both arrived as 1728 by 4112 pixels, 204 by 391 dpi. The price does not change. The job echoes the level.

sender_name.title: Sender Name
sender_name.description: The name that identifies the sender. The carrier gets it as the caller name for its header line. A fax without a cover sheet prints it in one line at the top of page one. The line also gives the sending number and the time in UTC. Letters, digits, spaces and - _ ~ ! . + only, at most 128 characters. Omit to use the organization's name.

delete_after_send.title: Delete After Send
delete_after_send.description: Delete the document and the transmitted copy the moment the fax ends in delivered, partial or failed. The job, its receipt and the carrier evidence stay; they hold no document content. A fax that ends unknown keeps the document until a reconcile settles it. Default: keep the document for the retention period.

cover_pages.title: Cover Pages
cover_pages.description: How many of the billable pages are the cover sheet: 0 or 1.

one_time.description: Set on the receipt of a fax that a one-time order paid for. It names the order, its status, the card and the amount the card was authorized for. captured_micro in it is the amount charged, written once the payment provider confirmed the capture. For a card order read the money here. Null for a fax paid from the wallet.

confirm.title: Confirm
confirm.description: The number itself, typed out, to confirm.

destination.title: Destination
destination.description: Apply to one destination; omit for every send.

from.title: From
from.description: A number your organization owns, E.164.

strict.title: Strict
strict.description: Refuse with page_limit_exceeded when the document has more pages than would be read, instead of reading the first ones and warning.

amount_usd.title: Amount Usd
amount_usd.description: Whole US dollars, 10 to 1000 per session.

url.title: Url
url.description: The hosted Checkout page while the session is open.

sha256.title: Sha256
sha256.description: Optional: fail if the bytes differ.

content_type.title: Content Type
content_type.description: application/pdf, image/png, image/jpeg or image/tiff. An image becomes 8-bit gray letter pages, since fax is monochrome. A frame wider than it is tall is rotated. A frame above 300 dpi letter is downsampled. Every TIFF frame is a page. PNG and JPEG take the first frame. The bytes must be the declared type.

event_types.title: Event Types
event_types.description: Empty or omitted: every event type.

secret.title: Secret
secret.description: whsec_... Shown once. Verify webhook-signature with it.

default_environment.title: Default Environment
default_environment.description: The environment the dashboard opens on: live once the organization has a funded wallet or a paid one-time order, else test.

bearerAuth.description: An API key from the dashboard: Authorization: Bearer ffa_live_... (or ffa_test_... for the sandbox). Scopes are chosen when the key is made. An operation names the one it asks for in x-required-scope.

apiKeyHeader.name: X-API-Key
apiKeyHeader.description: The same API key in X-API-Key, for a client that cannot set Authorization.

sessionCookie.name: __Host-ffa_session
sessionCookie.description: The dashboard's signed-in session. A state-changing call also repeats the session's CSRF token in X-CSRF-Token. The member's role decides the scopes.

orderToken.name: X-FFA-Order-Token
orderToken.description: The status token the create call of a one-time order answered. It gives access to that order alone. ?t= carries it where a header cannot be set.

signedUrl.name: sig
signedUrl.description: A short-lived signed URL the API handed out (exp and sig in the query). Use the URL as it was given. No API key is sent with it.

BadRequest.description: The request cannot be read or is refused as sent, for example invalid_request.

Unauthorized.description: No credential, or one that was not accepted: invalid_token for an API key, unauthenticated where a signed-in session is needed. error.details.reason says why a key was refused.

PaymentRequired.description: The prepaid balance does not cover the call: insufficient_balance.

Forbidden.description: The credential is valid and is not allowed to do this. scope_missing puts the scope in error.details.scope. Other codes are agent_forbidden and approval_required. A session can also meet csrf_invalid and reauth_required.

NotFound.description: not_found: no such resource for this credential. A resource of another organization answers the same.

Conflict.description: The resource is in a state that refuses the call, or the Idempotency-Key was used with a different request (idempotency_key_conflict). error.code names the state.

PayloadTooLarge.description: The body is larger than the limit of this call: payload_too_large.

UnprocessableContent.description: A field failed validation: invalid_request, with one entry per field in error.details, or a code that names the rule.

TooManyRequests.description: rate_limited. Retry-After and the RateLimit-* headers say when to try again.

ServiceUnavailable.description: Something this call depends on is not available or not set up here, for example billing_unavailable or provider_unavailable. error.retryable says whether to send the same call again.
